{"consolidated_memory":"INTERMITTENT EOF IN CRYPTO/TLS/HANDSHAKE.GO — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents occurred in the same component (crypto/tls/handshake.go, security side) and shared the same symptom (unexpected end of stream during negotiation), but had distinct root causes and manifested under different conditions.

OCCASION 1: 2026-01-27
- Scope: Five percent rollout bucket
- Repro: Open many short lived connections in a row
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #3470, branch fix/intermittent-eof-1
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 4.4 s to 927 ms

OCCASION 2: 2026-04-01
- Scope: Occurred when two requests raced on the same key
- Repro: Open many short lived connections in a row
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #7406, branch fix/intermittent-eof-2
- Outcome: Memory settled at 821 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

OCCASION 3: 2026-06-26
- Scope: Appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: Open many short lived connections in a row
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #8896, branch fix/intermittent-eof-3
- Outcome: Flaky test went from 42 failures per hundred runs to zero

NOTE: All three incidents occurred in the same corner of crypto/tls/handshake.go, so development context carried over across fixes."}
